summary: BUG-0167: Isolate native GFS2 access probes by host while retaining full validation. API impact: existing contract.

guide.reason: Internal diagnostic-probe layout only; operator workflows, resource settings and safety requirements are unchanged.

api.reason: API impact: existing contract. The shared native QEMU access helper serves monitor, repository/cluster validation and VM/recovery callers; each retains its existing result and full safety checks. No Controller/Core or client-facing schema changes.

roadmap.reason: Reliability correction within the current storage milestone; no new published capability or phase completion.

state.reason: Host-derived empty probe leaves and unique temporary probe files are regenerable filesystem artifacts, not durable settings, cached health or execution authority. Core-owned pool records and inventory/adoption remain unchanged.

verification.method: The controlled five-pair native comparison supports directory contention as a contributor. Initial strict-path implementation passed unit/race/source checks and clean deployment, but the selected GFS root mode 2770 correctly selected its original full-probe fallback. That candidate passed 150 idle samples per member but retained six distinct deadlines during the all-six-writer overlap, despite payload integrity. Revised descriptor-anchored source supports the existing group-writable root without changing its permissions; independent source review passed. The revised old-root overlay failed as intended; fixed rename/replacement, held-filesystem/mount, ownership/mode, concurrency, cleanup and actual child-process cases plus full vmhost/agent normal/race suites passed. Candidate-bound actual libvirt-qemu native command-chain proof passed without skips on all three hosts, and the revised rollout passed independent audit. The following 150-sample idle window retained one distinct Core2 deadline across three polls; Core3 was healthy throughout. Revised loaded verification and repository reliability acceptance remain open.
